description: UK Annual Accounts - Companies House Financial Statements. Get the annual accounts UK companies filed at Companies House, by company number (8 digits, or SC/NI/OC/SO/NC + 6 digits; leading zeros optional; up to 1,000): turnover, gross and operating profit, profit before tax, profit for the year, total/fixed/current assets, cash, net assets (equity), share capital, creditors within and after one year, total liabilities and average employees, with the prior year from the same filing. One row per company, financial year (1-5 most recent) and statement type (company, plus group figures on request). ukFigures adds the UK lines: net current assets, total assets less current liabilities, net assets, tangible/intangible assets, stock, debtors, trade debtors and creditors, bank loans within and after one year, provisions, retained earnings, advances to directors and, when filed, cost of sales, administrative expenses, interest, tax, staff costs, depreciation, dividends and directors' remuneration. Most UK companies are small or micro-entities that file no profit and loss account: then revenue and profit are null and incomeStatementFiled is false - that is what was filed, not missing data. Charities: revenue = total income, netProfit = net income/expenditure, equity = total funds (charity: true). Missing minus signs on net current liabilities / net liabilities are corrected only when the filed balance sheet proves it, listed in _corrections. Accounts filed only on paper or as a scanned PDF - most listed groups and many large companies - come back as an uncharged pdf_only row with a link, not figures. Not found, no filings and invalid numbers are uncharged failure rows. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyIds.description: UK company registration numbers, up to 1,000 per run. England and Wales: 8 digits (02203536). Scotland: SC + 6 digits. Northern Ireland: NI + 6 digits. LLPs: OC, SO or NC + 6 digits.
companyIds.title: Company numbers

includeConsolidated.description: Also return the consolidated group figures next to the parent company's own figures when the company files group accounts. Each group statement is an extra row and an extra charge. Companies whose filing carries group figures only get them either way. Off by default.
includeConsolidated.title: Include group (consolidated) accounts

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

years.description: How many of the most recent annual accounts to return for each company (1 to 5). Each year is one row and one charge.
years.title: Financial years per company

name: regdata_uk_annual_accounts
